sources.title: GitHub - 907436752/CoopDet3D · GitHub
sources.snippet: We propose CoopDet3D, a cooperative multi-modal fusion model, and TUMTraf-V2X, a dataset for the cooperative 3D object detection and tracking task. Our dataset contains 2,000 labeled point clouds and 5,000 labeled images from five roadside and four onboard sensors.

sources.title: TUMTraf V2X Cooperative Perception Dataset
sources.snippet: We propose CoopDet3D, a cooperative multi-modal fusion model, and TUMTraf-V2X, a perception dataset, for the cooperative 3D object detection and tracking task. Our dataset contains 2,000 labeled point clouds and 5,000 labeled images from five roadside and four onboard sensors.
